newsitem.title: USA: Westmark Group says loans increase.
newsitem.headline: Westmark Group says loans increase.

text.p: Westmark Group Holdings Inc said Tuesday that its subsidiary, Westmark Mortgage Corp, produced $9.6 million in loans in May 1997, a 158 percent increase over the $3.7 million in loans for May 1996.

Westmark Mortgage also produced $39.3 million in non-conforming loans for the first five months of 1997, a 248 percent increase over the $11.3 million in non-conforming loans for the first five months of 1996.

Westmark Group is a financial services holding company which through Westmark Mortgage is engaged in the nationwide origination, purchase and sale to investors of primarily non-conforming loans secured by residential properties.
